about: Plan-validation cases shared by the server and the client (TESTING_ROADMAP item 5).
The server's PlanValidator (server/tests/RpgGame.Rules.Tests/PlanValidatorTests.cs) and the client's validatePlan
(client/src/app/state/encounter/plan-queue.spec.ts) both run every case, so a rule only one side has fails CI.
A case: optional maxAp / movementRange / start ([x, y], or null for no position) / abilities (ids from the library
below) / cooldowns ({ id: roundsLeft }) / positions ({ id: [x, y] }, for moves to a target), a queue and the expected
result: { ap, cells } when the plan is legal, or { error } with the server's exact message (the first rule broken).
Queue entries: 'move X,Y' (or 'move' with no cell), 'melee ID', 'ranged ID', 'stabilize ID', 'defend', and
The abilities are test versions (only what validation reads); they don't follow the shipped abilities.json.
